arithmetic: Decimal precision 34 in local context; no process-global precision change
capital_model: Cash is initial collateral plus realized PnL and signed funding minus fees; opening a short does not credit sale notional

costs.formula: fee = abs(executed base quantity) * actual modeled execution price * fee_bps / 10000
costs.slippage: Buy above reference, sell below reference; embedded in fill PnL, reported separately but never deducted twice
costs.status: Explicit diagnostic assumptions only, not a quote for any OKX account or future M3 research fee schedule

currency: USDT collateral, linear perpetuals; signed base-asset quantities, not contract counts

eligibility.candidate_registry: M1 availability registry, all 28 unordered pairs and 6 alt/BTC/ETH baskets; not a reconstructed historical universe
eligibility.complete_first_day: ceil(max(verified listing time, verified continuous tradability time) to UTC day); midnight is already complete

lagged_turnover_rule.invalid: missing, empty, nonfinite or negative value rejects window; no zero fill
lagged_turnover_rule.status: fixed diagnostic liquidity floor, not historically ranked universe or capacity estimate; not chosen using OOS returns
lagged_turnover_rule.window: [t-30 days,t), excludes current t and future data
lagged_turnover_rule.zero: valid observation; all-zero window fails numerical threshold

eligibility.metadata_missing_or_unverified: true eligible dates unknown; never substitute acquisition first day; report provisional current-metadata diagnostics separately
eligibility.provisional_rule: For each leg, require t >= complete first day + 180 days; require 56 preceding full post-admission days and current day plus lagged 30 turnover days; intersect legs
eligibility.scope: 56/30 are frozen data-readiness diagnostics, not convergence signal parameters selected using returns
eligibility.test_qualification: none until verified point-in-time tradability and history exist; provisional day counts do not enter FDR

execution.next_tick: First declared executable timestamp strictly after known_at; equal timestamp never fills
execution.overlap: Reject a later signal touching a leg while its earlier fill is still pending
execution.partial_fill: Record actual quantity and residual target; do not retry automatically or invent completion
execution.publication_boundary: M3 must supply actual close/data availability time; never stamp a completed daily candle before its close to force a same-boundary fill
execution.signal_information: Caller supplies point-in-time target base quantities and true availability timestamp; M2 does not fit signals or hedge ratios
execution.stress: Additional execution-tick delays and deterministic fill fractions in [0,1]
execution.terminal: No invented final-close fill; open positions remain marked and are separately reported

execution_audit.count_scope: derive attempts/completions from available log; never global historical total
execution_audit.historical_counts: unknown; legacy values are author claims without independent run logs
execution_audit.real_window_in_this_revision: disabled; do not rerun for evidence repair

funding.boundary: Convention is frozen for diagnostics, not an assertion of exchange race ordering at exact settlement milliseconds
funding.formula: cashflow = -signed base quantity held before timestamp * settlement mark price * realized funding rate
funding.missing: Reject absent or nonfinite actual rates and contemporaneous marks before any cash or position mutation
funding.same_timestamp: Existing holdings settle before any fills, including closes; positions opened at that timestamp do not pay that settlement
funding.schedule: Explicit independently declared per-instrument settlement calendar; do not infer completeness from the returned rate rows

integration.full_research_conclusion: always unavailable at M2; preserve original training and locked OOS requirements
integration.this_revision_policy: No real-window execution; only verify preserved cached artifact values and provenance limitations

ledger: Monotonic event sequence, cash, realized/unrealized PnL, equity, fees, signed funding, slip diagnostic, per-book positions and absolute asset exposure
model_boundaries: No exchange initial/maintenance margin tiers, liquidation engine, ADL, collateral haircut, bankruptcy recovery or insurance fund model
No order-book depth, queue position, probabilistic fills, tick/lot rounding, contract migration or exchange minimum order-size model
Per-book virtual legs are not a claim that the exchange can maintain offsetting positions in net mode
No coin borrowing; perpetual collateral cashflows do not imply short-sale proceeds or borrowed spot inventory
Volatility targeting, stationarity tests, half-life, beta estimation and convergence signal validation remain M3 work
purpose: Independent offline accounting engine and deterministic verification; not M3 signal selection or research returns

risk.drift: Detect after mark/funding; halt new exposure, cancel pending legs, flatten each held leg at its next strictly later executable tick
risk.halt_lifecycle: No automatic strategy restart in a diagnostic run
risk.insolvency: Reject result on nonpositive equity; do not fabricate liquidation execution or recovery
risk.order_gate: Evaluate caps against projected post-fee and post-slippage equity; allow reducing same-side positions to exit a breach
risk.shared_asset_policy: Sum absolute exposures across books, even for opposing directions
risk.unresolved_exit: Flag unresolved if the dataset ends before a required exit; never assume execution

source_separation: Executable trade prices and settlement/valuation mark prices are different inputs; no substitution or forward fill
